name: Cyxtera

profile.reading: This facility is attributed to Cyxtera, a data center and colocation company formed in May 2017 when CenturyLink, now Lumen Technologies, sold its entire data center and colocation business to funds advised by BC Partners, together with Medina Capital Advisors and Longview Asset Management, for approximately 1.86 billion dollars; CenturyLink retained a 10 percent equity stake in the new company, as documented in Wikipedia coverage of Lumen Technologies researched earlier in this session. Cologix own site, also fetched this session, states that Cologix acquired Cyxtera in 2023, meaning the two operator names now recorded separately in this registry, Cologix and Cyxtera, are very likely connected, with this Cyxtera facility now part of the Cologix organization following that 2023 transaction. No founding date beyond the 2017 CenturyLink divestiture, headquarters address, or building specific address and MW figures for this particular registry row were located in available sourcing this session.
profile.research_note: Strong chain of evidence: CenturyLink/Lumen sold its data center business to form Cyxtera in 2017, and Cologix acquired Cyxtera in 2023 per Cologix own site. This connects three separate operator records in this registry (Lumen Technologies, Cyxtera, Cologix) as likely successive owners of the same underlying facility lineage; flagged for a future reconciliation pass rather than reassigned now.

reading:
Cyxtera is the earliest of three brand names this registry carries for the same underlying colocation platform. Cyxtera Technologies was spun out of CenturyLink infrastructure assets in 2017, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in June 2023, and was acquired by Brookfield Infrastructure for $775 million in a deal that closed in January 2024. Brookfield then combined the Cyxtera assets with Evoque Data Center Solutions, a separate company it had formed in 2019 from AT&T's divested data center assets, under a new Centersquare brand launched in April 2024, which has since rebranded again to Csquare.

This registry keeps this Cyxtera row intact rather than deleting or merging it, per this assignment's rule against deleting registry data, and cross-links it as a duplicate_of the canonical Csquare entry, uid d01580f9, where the full corporate lineage, ownership, and 2026 IPO filing detail are recorded, with the intermediate Centersquare brand tracked separately at uid fe5f655b. Reconciling which of the three facilities tracked under this Cyxtera row belong to the same physical buildings as facilities tracked under the Centersquare or Csquare operator rows is left to the facility-level research phase of this assignment, not resolved here.

The registry tracks these three Cyxtera-named facilities across three states, Florida, New Jersey, and Texas.
